categories.name: Overview
categories.summary: Every signal for a domain or Microsoft 365 tenant in one report.

tools.name: M365 Tenant Overview
tools.description: Aggregate Microsoft 365 tenant, identity, DNS, and mail posture in one dashboard
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.Verify("example.com");

tools.name: Domain Overview
tools.description: Aggregate DNS, mail, web, registration, and exposure posture for any domain
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.Verify("example.com");

categories.name: Email Security
categories.summary: Who may send as the domain, and what receivers do with spoofed mail.

tools.name: Email Message Analyzer
tools.description: Analyze message headers and verify DKIM/ARC locally with offline public keys. Message content stays in your browser.
tools.csharp:
using var health = new DomainHealthCheck();
var analysis = await health.AnalyzeMessageFileAsync("message.eml");

tools.name: SPF Lookup
tools.description: Validate SPF records and check for misconfigurations
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifySPF("example.com");

tools.name: DKIM Lookup
tools.description: Verify DKIM records and key validity
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDKIM("example.com", new[] { "selector1" });

tools.name: DMARC Lookup
tools.description: Analyze DMARC policy and reporting configuration
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDMARC("example.com");

tools.name: MX Lookup
tools.description: Check mail exchanger records and priorities
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyMX("example.com");

tools.name: MTA-STS Check
tools.description: Verify MTA-STS policy for enforced TLS
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyMTASTS("example.com");

tools.name: TLS-RPT Check
tools.description: Check TLS reporting DNS record configuration
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyTLSRPT("example.com");

tools.name: BIMI Lookup
tools.description: Validate BIMI record and brand indicator
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyBIMI("example.com");

categories.name: DNS
categories.summary: Records, delegation, propagation and the DNSSEC chain of trust.

tools.name: DNS Lookup
tools.description: Inspect a domain's DNS inventory, providers, and common record coverage
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDnsInventoryAsync("example.com");

tools.name: DNSSEC Check
tools.description: Validate DNSSEC chain of trust
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDNSSEC("example.com");

tools.name: SOA Lookup
tools.description: Check SOA record and zone authority
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifySOA("example.com");

tools.name: NS Lookup
tools.description: List authoritative nameservers
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyNS("example.com");

tools.name: DNS Propagation
tools.description: Compare DNS answers across DomainDetective's distributed public resolver pool
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDnsPropagationAsync("example.com");

tools.name: Raw DNS Query
tools.description: Resolve one record type at a time, inspect the raw JSON response, and copy equivalent DnsClientX code

categories.name: TLS & Certificates
categories.summary: Certificates, which authorities may issue them, and DANE pins.

tools.name: Certificate Check
tools.description: Inspect TLS certificate details and chain
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyWebsiteCertificate("example.com");
tools.localReason: It opens a TLS connection to the server and reads the certificate chain. Web pages cannot open raw TLS connections or see certificates.

tools.name: CAA Lookup
tools.description: Check Certificate Authority Authorization records
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyCAA("example.com");

tools.name: DANE Check
tools.description: Validate DANE/TLSA records
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDANE("example.com", new[] { 443 });

categories.name: Web Security
categories.summary: The security headers and contact details a website publishes.

tools.name: HTTP Headers
tools.description: Analyze security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyWebsiteHttps("example.com");
tools.localReason: It requests the website and reads every response header. Browsers stop one site from reading another site's responses unless that site allows it.

tools.name: Security.txt
tools.description: Check for security.txt disclosure file
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifySecurityTxt("example.com");
tools.localReason: It downloads /.well-known/security.txt from the domain. Browsers stop one site from reading another site's files unless that site allows it.

categories.name: Threat Intelligence
categories.summary: Blocklist listings and dangling records open to takeover.

tools.name: DNSBL Check
tools.description: Check domain/IP against DNS blacklists
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDNSBL("example.com");

tools.name: Dangling CNAME
tools.description: Detect dangling CNAME records vulnerable to takeover
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyDanglingCname("example.com");

categories.name: Registration
categories.summary: Registrar, owner and expiry through RDAP and WHOIS.

tools.name: RDAP / WHOIS
tools.description: Query domain registration data via RDAP
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.QueryRDAP("example.com");
tools.localReason: It asks the registry's RDAP service for registration data. That lookup is not part of the browser edition yet.

categories.name: Web Discovery
categories.summary: Sitemaps and how ready the site is for AI agents.

tools.name: Sitemap XML Analyzer
tools.description: Validate sitemap XML, sitemap indexes, duplicate URLs, redirects, redirect loops, noindex, and canonical mismatches
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifySitemapAsync("example.com");
tools.localReason: It downloads robots.txt and the sitemaps from the website. Browsers stop one site from reading another site's files unless that site allows it.

tools.name: AI Agent Readiness
tools.description: Assess robots, llms.txt, markdown access, Link headers, agent discovery endpoints, and trust signals for AI crawlers and agents
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.csharp:
var hc = new DomainHealthCheck();
await hc.VerifyAgentReadinessAsync("example.com");
tools.localReason: It downloads robots.txt, llms.txt and other files from the website and reads their headers. Browsers stop one site from reading another site's files unless that site allows it.

categories.name: Subdomain Discovery
categories.summary: Subdomains revealed by Certificate Transparency logs.

tools.name: CT Subdomain Discovery
tools.description: Discover subdomains via Certificate Transparency logs
tools.supportLabel: Runs locally with PowerShell or the CLI
tools.localReason: It searches public Certificate Transparency logs. The free public search services are too slow and unreliable to call from a web page, so this check stays local.
